headline_marked: 2 Bangladeshis dead, 24 injured in [[missile attack on Riyadh airport]]
headline: 2 Bangladeshis dead, 24 injured in missile attack on Riyadh airport
summary: A missile strike on King Khalid International Airport's Terminal 3 left 12 people dead and hundreds injured, including dozens of Bangladeshis.
details: A missile strike on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, has left two Bangladeshis dead and 24 others injured. The attack occurred around 3:15 AM on October 10, hitting Terminal 3 of the airport.

According to the Bangladesh Embassy in Riyadh, the total casualties of the attack include 12 deaths and 309 injuries. The deceased Bangladeshis have been identified as Shahed Ahmed from Bogura and Nasrullah Badarpuri from Cumilla.

Among the injured Bangladeshis, 11 are workers and 13 are Umrah pilgrims. Several are receiving treatment at various hospitals, including King Abdullah Hospital, National Guard Hospital, and Riyadh Medical Hospital.

Three Bangladeshis are currently in the ICU at King Abdullah Hospital, with their conditions reported as stable. Others are being treated at Prince Sultan Military Hospital, Prince Mohammed bin Abdulaziz Hospital, and several other medical facilities.

The attack caused significant disruption to flights, leaving approximately 500 passengers, including many Bangladeshis, stranded. The embassy has arranged for accommodation and food for those affected.

Special arrangements were made to transport 67 Umrah pilgrims from Riyadh to Jeddah via special buses. Additionally, about 400 passengers on a cancelled Saudi Airlines flight to Dhaka were rerouted through King Fahd International Airport in Dammam.

headline_marked: Sadaqat's storm: [[Pakistan beats Sri Lanka by 82 runs]] in 2nd T20I
headline: Sadaqat's storm: Pakistan beats Sri Lanka by 82 runs in 2nd T20I
summary: Maz Sadaqat's explosive 96 and Sahibzada Farhan's 73 powered Pakistan to a massive 215-run total, crushing Sri Lanka in the second T20I.
details: Pakistan secured a dominant 82-run victory over Sri Lanka in the second T20I, following a massive total of 215 for 3 in their 20 overs.
Maz Sadaqat led the charge with a blistering 96 runs off 51 balls, including 7 sixes and 6 fours, boasting a strike rate of 188.23.
Sahibzada Farhan provided strong support at the other end, scoring a rapid 73 runs off 44 balls to help build the mountainous total.
Sri Lanka struggled to keep up with the required run rate, eventually being bowled out for 133 runs for 7 wickets in their 20 overs.
Despite resistance from Maheesh Theekshana, who scored 32 runs off 26 balls, the Sri Lankan batting lineup failed to create pressure on the Pakistani bowlers.
Mohammad Imran was the standout performer with the ball, taking 3 wickets for just 11 runs in his 4-over spell.
With this win, Pakistan takes a commanding lead in the series. The third and final match of the series will be place on Tuesday.
caption:
96 runs, 7 sixes, and an 82-run win! Maz Sadaqat's batting masterclass puts Pakistan in control.

Pakistan secured a dominant 82-run victory over Sri Lanka in the second T20I, following a massive total of 215 for 3 in their 20 overs.

Maz Sadaqat led the charge with a blistering 96 runs off 51 balls, including 7 sixes and 6 fours, boasting a strike rate of 188.23.

Sahibzada Farhan provided strong support at the other end, scoring a rapid 73 runs off 44 balls to help build the mountainous total.

Sri Lanka struggled to keep up with the required run rate, eventually being bowled out for 133 runs for 7 wickets in their 20 overs.

Despite resistance from Maheesh Theekshana, who scored 32 runs off 26 balls, the Sri Lankan batting lineup failed to create pressure on the Pakistani bowlers.

Mohammad Imran was the standout performer with the ball, taking 3 wickets for just 11 runs in his 4-over spell.

With this win, Pakistan takes a commanding lead in the series. The third and final match of the series will be place on Tuesday.
